battle.name: 阿瓦爾戰爭
battle.theater: 多瑙河中游阿瓦爾邊疆
battle.brief: 788年，查理曼不親征，遣子丕平與外甥奧爾良的威廉率法蘭克大軍渡多瑙河深入阿瓦爾，平定其內亂、俘其可汗，並奪得被視為阿瓦爾護符的「環」。卡面的斯巴達長矛是同時代拜占庭對付阿瓦爾騎兵的長矛代表：兩米木杆、槍尾銅套，前排抵地承重成陣，與法蘭克步騎的長矛同屬對抗遊牧騎兵的技術。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 這場戰爭是法蘭克王國對阿瓦爾可汗國的一次軍事干預，發生在788年，多瑙河東岸的阿瓦爾邊疆。法蘭克一方由國王查理曼統率，他沒有親征，而是派兒子義大利王丕平與外甥奧爾良的威廉率領一支編年史稱為「大軍」的遠征部隊越過多瑙河；法蘭克軍隊的骨架是各伯率領的戰鬥團，即重騎兵結成的密集騎兵方陣，由宮相與地方伯爵分節制，步兵則由地方徵召，配以結盾牆的長矛隊與弩手。阿瓦爾一方是一個已經分裂的草原帝國：可汗國在六世紀末建立，七世紀巔峰時控制由多瑙河到喀爾巴阡、由蒂薩河到特蘭西瓦尼亞的廣大牧地，首都與「環」在多瑙河與蒂薩河之間的盆地；到七八〇年代，可汗國同時受保加爾汗國與拜占庭東西兩面擠壓，汗位繼承引發內鬥，783年更爆發過一次由萬尼那樣僭稱先知引導的起義，部眾與地方首領各自為戰。可汗國的部分貴族在內鬥中向法蘭克求援，法蘭克以援助友邦平叛的名義進入，實則趁機奪取可汗與其護符，把邊界線推到多瑙河東岸。同一時節，拜占庭在巴爾幹前線與保加爾人拉鋸，巴伐利亞則在七八八年被法蘭克平定，帝國同時在數條戰線上作戰。
countriesEn: This war was a Frankish intervention against the Avar Khaganate, fought in 788 on the eastern bank of the Danube, in the Avar March. The Frankish side was under King Charlemagne, who did not campaign in person but sent his son Pepin of Italy and his nephew William of Orléans at the head of an expeditionary force that the annals call a great army. Its backbone was the comital bands, dense blocks of heavy cavalry led by counts and directed by the count of the palace and the local counts, with foot soldiers mustered from the counties to form spear-and-shield walls, together with crossbowmen. The Avar side was a grassland empire that had already come apart. The khaganate was founded in the late sixth century and at its seventh-century height controlled pasture from the Danube to the Carpathians and from the Tisza to Transylvania, its capital and its Ring lying in the basin between the Danube and the Tisza. By the 780s it was squeezed from east and west at once, by the Bulgar khaganate and by Byzantium; struggles over the succession tore it apart, and in 783 a rising led by a false prophet of the Vani type broke out and ended with its own leader killed by his followers. Some Avar nobles, locked in that internecine strife, called on the Franks for help, and the Franks entered under the banner of assisting an ally against rebels, in fact seizing the khagan and his talisman and pushing the frontier to the far bank of the Danube. Byzantium was grinding against the Bulgars on the Balkan front in the same season, and Bavaria had just been subdued by the Franks in 788, so the empire was fighting on several fronts at once.
people: 本役的關鍵人物多在戰線之外。查理曼大帝自己留守帝國中樞，他不下場廝殺，靠的是把兩位能打的家族成員一次派出去。駝背的丕平是他的兒子與義大利王，早年曾於七八五年率軍平定阿格萊夫西亞地區的叛公爵維林哈里姆，熟悉在帝國內地應付叛亂的兵事。奧爾良的威廉是他的外甥，奧爾良伯爵，以正面衝鋒與奔襲著稱。這支部隊真正決定戰局的是一場混合式的會戰，而阿瓦爾可汗恰恰在混亂中被法蘭克騎兵衝散時連同近侍被俘。可汗的名字在法蘭克史料裡常被略去，後世對他是七八八年被俘的那位，還是七九一年最後一位可汗茲沃內米爾，有爭議，較可靠的看法是兩人並非同一人。宮相阿爾諾是後續的關鍵人物，他率法蘭克援軍在七九〇年的阿瓦爾叛亂中於維也納森林一帶擊潰叛軍，叛軍首領被擒後絞殺，維也納森林因此成為這場戰爭少數有明確地名的戰場。記錄此事的艾因哈德留下《查理曼傳》與《福爾德年鑑》，而約八〇年前後洛爾施福音書的《阿瓦爾人受洗圖》插畫把奪環與受洗的場面定格：查理曼高坐於上，被毀的環擱在腳邊，跪著的是阿瓦爾首領。
peopleEn: The decisive figures in this war were mostly off the battlefield. Charlemagne himself stayed in the imperial centre; he did not fight, and won instead by putting two able members of the royal house in the field at once. Pepin the Hunchback, his son and king of Italy, had already led the Frankish army that defeated Werinharim, the rebel duke of the Aglefsians, in 785, and knew how to handle rebellions in the interior of the empire. William of Orléans, his nephew and count of Orléans, was known for the frontal charge and for running down fleeing enemies. What decided the engagement was a combined-arms action, and the Avar khagan was taken in the confusion when the Frankish cavalry broke into his camp and his attendants with him. The khagan's name is usually omitted in the Frankish sources, and there is debate over whether he was the khagan captured in 788 or Zvonemir, the last khagan of 791; the better view is that the two were not the same man. The count of the palace Arno is the key figure of the aftermath: he led the Frankish relief force and crushed the Avar revolt of 790 in the area of the Vienna Woods, where the rebel leader was taken and hanged, which makes the woods one of the few places in this war with a secure name attached to a battle. The chronicler Einhard left the Vita Karoli and the Annales Fuldenses, and the Conversion of the Avars illumination in the Lorsch Gospels of about 810 fixed the moment of the ring and the baptism on record: Charlemagne enthroned above, the broken ring lying at his feet, the Avar chiefs kneeling below.
kits: 卡面這件斯巴達長矛是希臘世界的兩米長矛，葉形矛頭縛在木杆上，槍尾套銅。銅套不是裝飾，hoplite陣中前排把槍尾抵在地面借力，後排推著前排的背，整列長矛就成一堵能頂住衝鋒的牆；兩米的長度還能讓矛尖越過自己人的盾緣刺向敵人側面。進入拜占庭時代這種長矛並未退場，八世紀的主題軍步卒仍持同類長矛，多瑙河防線上的拜占庭守軍正是靠它對抗阿瓦爾輕騎兵的箭雨與衝撞，所以這件兵器在七八八年仍是與阿瓦爾交戰的長矛之代表。卡面兵器並不屬於法蘭克軍械：法蘭克步兵用本地直刺長矛與大盾結陣，投擲斧與雙刃劍仍在役，騎兵用可挾於腋下的長槍；頭盔是萊茵地區出產的鐵環盔，鎧甲是歐洲早期的鎖子甲，弩在八世紀已列入法蘭克軍械。阿瓦爾一方則是另一套裝備體系：反曲複合弓、馬刀、短矛，幾乎不穿甲的輕裝騎兵，與數量可觀的馬匹、帳幕及隨行車隊。他們的防禦器械是環，以木柵與土牆圍成的大圈要塞，牆外挖壕，牆內紮營，環牆周長在法蘭克編年史裡被形容為步行環行需一年，雖是誇辭，卻顯示其尺度遠超一般營寨。
kitsEn: The Dory on the card is a Greek two-metre spear with a leaf-shaped head bound to a wooden shaft and a copper socket at the butt. The socket is no ornament: in the hoplite phalanx the front rank grounded the butt to take the weight, the rank behind pressed on the backs of the men in front, and a whole file of spears became a wall that could absorb a charge; at two metres the point could also reach past a comrade's shield to strike an enemy in the flank. The weapon did not retire with the end of the classical world. In Byzantine service the same long spear was still carried by the themed foot soldiers, the skoutatoi, in the eighth century, and the Byzantine garrisons of the Danube line relied on exactly that weapon against Avar light horse and their arrows, so in 788 the Dory remained the type of spear with which one fought the Avars. The card weapon was not Frankish equipment, however. Frankish foot used native thrusting spears of the framea type behind large shields, with the throwing axe and the double-edged sword still in service, while the cavalry carried lances couched under the arm; helmets were the iron spangenhelm of Rhineland manufacture, armour was the early European mail shirt, and the crossbow was already listed among Frankish weapons. The Avars ran a different equipment system altogether: recurved composite bows, sabres, short spears, light cavalry in little or no armour, and a great number of horses, tents and wagons that moved with them. Their fortification was the Ring, a vast circular enclosure of timber palisade and earthwork with a ditch outside and the camp inside it. The chroniclers said it took a year to walk round the wall, which is an exaggeration, but it shows that the scale was far beyond an ordinary fortified camp.
tactics: 法蘭克的打法是把步與騎綁在一起。渡過多瑙河之後，步兵先在河岸與營地外圍結成密集盾牆，長矛從盾縫中斜指前方，用來頂住阿瓦爾輕騎的試衝與箭雨；弩手與弓箭手分列兩翼，不斷射擊騎兵隊形較鬆的側翼；真正決定勝負的是各伯率領的重騎兵結成的密集方陣，在號令下以挾槍的姿勢一次衝鋒，穿透阿瓦爾騎兵散亂的隊形。阿瓦爾的戰術意圖是避免與法蘭克重騎正面相撞，輕騎以弓矢覆蓋地面，嘗試包抄側翼、拖垮法蘭克陣線，勝算在於其機動力與補給全靠馬匹和遊牧營地，一旦退入環就能憑工事固守；然而內部的分裂與對指揮權的爭奪，使這種拖延策略在關鍵一刻失效，可汗與其近侍在營帳被衝破時被俘。對法蘭克而言，渡河作戰有先天弱點，補給線越過寬闊的多瑙河後被拉長，糧秣必須靠船隊與牛車往返維持，所以這場戰役的戰果取決於速戰速決、一戰定勝負，而不是圍城消耗。
tacticsEn: The Frankish method was to bind foot and horse together. After crossing the Danube, the infantry first closed into dense shield walls on the river bank and round the baggage, long spears slanting forward through the gaps to brace against Avar light horse probing the line and against their arrow showers; crossbowmen and archers were posted on the flanks, working at the looser parts of the Avar horse formation; what actually decided the battle was the close-order heavy cavalry of the counts, charging in a single movement with lances couched and breaking through the disordered Avar horse. The Avar plan was to avoid a frontal collision with the Frankish heavy horse: light cavalry covered the ground with arrows, tried to work round the flanks and wear down the Frankish line, and could fall back into the Ring to hold behind works, with mobility and supply carried entirely by horses and a moving camp. But internal division and quarrels over command made that delaying strategy fail at the decisive moment, and the khagan was taken with his entourage when the camp was broken. The Frankish method had an inherent weakness once they had crossed the river: the supply line stretched on the far side of a broad Danube, and provisions had to be ferried by boat and carried by ox-cart, so the result of the campaign depended on speed and on a single decisive action rather than on a siege reduced by attrition.
data: 關於七八八年這場戰役，可靠的數字非常有限，法蘭克編年史沒有留下可核對的兵力表，因此只能寫有根據者。可汗國在五五〇年代建立、七九〇年代崩解，前後約兩百三十年；其控制的牧地在巔峰時橫跨多瑙河與蒂薩河之間的喀爾巴阡盆地，是歐亞草原世界最西端的大型國家之一。環的規模在編年史中被描述為環行一周需一年，屬誇大之辭，但足以說明它是多瑙河畔最大的環形要塞之一，而非一般營寨。法蘭克方面可確認的是，這支部隊被稱為大軍，主力為各伯的騎兵團，並配有大量步兵與弩手；它必須在敵境完成渡河、會戰、追擊與俘獲，因此由兩位王族分別率領分段指揮。多瑙河全長約二千八百六十公里，從法蘭克邊境到可汗國核心仍有數日行程，糧秣運抵前沿全靠河運。武器尺度則是硬數據：斯巴達長矛全長約一百八十五至二百一十厘米，槍尾有銅套，這個長度足以讓前排抵地承重、同時越過盾面刺擊。七九〇年叛軍被一次會戰擊敗，七九一年法蘭克再入阿瓦爾地攻陷環，七九五年前後集體受洗，七年之間一個草原帝國被拆解。
dataEn: Reliable figures for the campaign of 788 are scarce, because the Frankish annals leave no muster table that can be checked, so only grounded numbers can be given. The khaganate was founded in the 550s and broke up in the 790s, a span of about two hundred and thirty years; at its height its pastures covered the Carpathian basin between the Danube and the Tisza, making it one of the largest states of the far western Eurasian steppe. The scale of the Ring is described in the annals as a wall that took a year to walk around, which is an exaggeration but enough to show that it was one of the largest circular fortresses on the Danube and not an ordinary camp. On the Frankish side what can be confirmed is that the force was called a great army, that its core was the comital cavalry, and that it carried a substantial body of foot and crossbowmen; having to cross the river, fight, pursue and take prisoners inside Avar territory, it was placed under two royal commanders so that it could be led in parts. The Danube runs about 2,860 kilometres, and from the Frankish frontier the heart of the khaganate was still several days' march away, with all provisions coming up the river. The dimensions of the weapon are hard data: a Dory was roughly 185 to 210 centimetres long with a copper socket at the butt, a length that let the front rank ground the shaft to bear its weight and still reach over the shields to strike. The rebels were beaten in a single action in 790, the Franks entered Avar territory again in 791 and took the Ring by siege, and the mass baptism followed around 795: in seven years a grassland empire was taken apart.
cause: 打起來的直接導火線在阿瓦爾一側。七七〇年代，可汗國在對保加爾人的戰爭中節節失利，汗位繼承又引發連續內鬥，783年更出現萬尼那樣自稱受神諭的領袖率眾起義、旋被自己人殺死的案例，中央對各部落的控制近乎瓦解。可汗國的貴族於是把法蘭克人拉進來，向法蘭克求援討伐叛部，等於請法蘭克騎兵帶著重裝備進入自己的心臟。查理曼樂見其成，七年來他一直想在多瑙河東岸建立穩固的邊界，把巴伐利亞、倫巴第與東邊的邊疆連成一條完整的防線，778年他還在比利牛斯山麓吃過一次敗仗，更需要在東線顯示壓力；而阿瓦爾騎兵年年越境劫掠邊民與修道院，是帝國邊郡最實際的威脅。於是友邦求援提供了法蘭克出兵的正當性，邊境安全提供了實際的收益，兩者合流便把一次平叛變成征服。拜占庭在巴爾幹收復失地後同樣希望削弱阿瓦爾，雖然帝國並未直接參戰，但對同樣的動向採取了默許與利用。
causeEn: The immediate spark lay on the Avar side. Through the 770s the khaganate lost ground in its wars with the Bulgars, the struggle over the succession produced repeated civil conflict, and the case of Vani in 783, a leader claiming a divine message who was then killed by his own people, showed that central control over the tribes had almost dissolved. Avar nobles then pulled the Franks in: to ask for Frankish help against rebels was to invite Frankish horse, fully equipped, into the heart of their own country. Charlemagne was glad of the opportunity, for seven years he had wanted a firm frontier on the far bank of the Danube, joining Bavaria, Lombardy and the eastern march into one continuous line of defence, and the defeat he had suffered in the Pyrenees in 778 demanded a display of pressure in the east. Avar horsemen also raided across the frontier every year, taking border folk and monasteries, and that was the most immediate threat the empire's border counties faced. The plea of the ally therefore supplied the Frankish army with a legitimate title, frontier security supplied the profit, and the two met to turn a pacification into a conquest. Byzantium, having recovered ground in the Balkans, likewise wanted the Avars weakened, and though the empire took no part it tolerated and exploited the same movement.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果直接改變了中歐的權力版圖。可汗國在七九一年被拆解後，其在蒂薩河與多瑙河之間的土地並入法蘭克帝國的邊疆體系，後來以匈牙利邊區的形式存在；大批阿瓦爾人與其治下的斯拉夫人被強行遷往薩克森、巴伐利亞等內地，被拆散編入法蘭克軍隊，阿瓦爾人從此成為帝國常備騎兵的重要來源，其名字在後來數百年的法蘭克與日耳曼軍事傳統中一直殘留。更深遠的是象徵層面，環被奪與被毀，等於宣告阿瓦爾人喪失了他們賴以維繫的天命；這件事被寫進了約八〇年前後的洛爾施福音書插畫，成為中世紀西歐基督教世界記憶中最鮮明的一幅政治圖像，被基督教化的草原帝國跪在皇帝腳下。對東羅馬而言，消滅阿瓦爾人等於抽走了一個長期壓迫多瑙河與色雷斯的因子，使帝國得以在七八〇年代末把主力轉向對保加爾的戰爭；對草原世界而言，歐亞草原最西端的勢力退出歷史舞台，也為九至十世紀匈牙利人進入同一片空間留下了空隙。
impactEn: The outcome of this war redrew the political map of central Europe. When the khaganate was broken up in 791, its lands between the Tisza and the Danube were folded into the Frankish frontier system, later existing as the Hungarian March. Large numbers of Avars and of the Slavs they ruled were forcibly moved back into Saxony, Bavaria and other interior regions, broken up and incorporated into the Frankish army, and the Avars became an important source of regular cavalry for the empire, their name lingering in Frankish and German military tradition for centuries afterwards. Deeper still is the symbolic layer: the seizure and the destruction of the Ring announced to the Avars that the fortune they had lived by was lost, and the deed was written into the c. 810 illumination of the Lorsch Gospels, becoming the sharpest political image in the memory of the medieval western European Christian world, a grassland empire, Christianised, kneeling at the emperor's feet. For the eastern Romans, the removal of the Avars took away a long-standing source of pressure on the Danube and the Thrace frontier, letting the empire turn its main effort against the Bulgars in the late 780s and 790s. For the steppe world, the disappearance of the most westerly power of the Eurasian steppe left a gap that the Hungarians of the ninth and tenth centuries were to fill.
result: 七八八年秋天的會戰以法蘭克完勝告終，阿瓦爾可汗連同近侍與多名首領被俘，連同被視為阿瓦爾護符與勝利保證的環一起落入法蘭克之手。可汗本人被帶回法蘭克，帝國隨即派兵接管阿瓦爾腹地，可汗國在形式上臣服。七九〇年反抗爆發，部分阿瓦爾首領企圖重奪環，宮相阿爾諾在維也納森林一帶擊潰叛軍，叛軍首領被擒後處死。真正的終結在七九一年，查理曼親率大軍再次進入阿瓦爾地，圍攻並攻破多瑙河畔的都城與環，環形防禦被拆毀，大批居民被擄往法蘭克本土，可汗國在政治與軍事上同時終結。阿瓦爾貴族約在七九五至七九七年之間集體受洗，最後一位可汗茲沃內米爾於八〇七年去世，獨立的阿瓦爾政體從此消失。卡面那支兩米長矛的技術傳統則延續下去，拜占庭的skoutatoi仍用它到十一世紀，法蘭克步騎混合的長矛邏輯也進入後來的匈牙利戰役。
resultEn: The engagement of 788 ended in a complete Frankish victory: the Avar khagan was taken with his attendants and a number of chiefs, and the Ring, held to be the Avars' talisman and guarantee of victory, fell into Frankish hands with him. The khagan was brought back to the Frankish realm, the empire at once sent troops to take up the Avar interior, and the khaganate submitted in form. In 790 resistance broke out, with Avar leaders trying to regain the Ring; the count of the palace Arno crushed the rebels in the area of the Vienna Woods, and the rebel leader was executed after capture. The real end came in 791: Charlemagne entered Avar territory once more at the head of a great army, besieged and took the capital and the Ring on the Danube, the circular defences were demolished, and large numbers of the inhabitants were carried off into the Frankish heartland, ending the khaganate in political and military terms at the same time. The Avar aristocracy was baptised in a mass ceremony between about 795 and 797, and the last khagan, Zvonemir, died in 807, after which no independent Avar polity survived. The technical tradition of the two-metre spear on the card continued: the Byzantine skoutatoi still carried the Dory into the eleventh century, and the Frankish combination of long spears with mounted shock carried on into the later Hungarian campaigns.
